verdict.rationale: Treg documents a stateless proxy and catalog for calling provider endpoints (via /call/, the CLI and MCP), but nothing in the evidence shows registrable triggers, webhooks or event subscriptions from connected apps. A community commenter notes the stateful half, including webhooks, signals and schedules, is where other tools still have the edge.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
